'''Thorium Point''' is a small, neutral town in northern [[Searing Gorge]] inhabited by the [[Thorium Brotherhood]].  

It has a flight path and the majority of the quests in the Searing Gorge as well as a couple of vendors. It is located northeast of [[Firewatch Ridge]] and is populated mostly by neutral [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron dwarves]]. It is a critical hub for farming [[Thorium Brotherhood]] reputation.

There is a [[forge]] and [[anvil]] at this location.
